task: Put the blue cube on the {colour} square.
object: blue G-Research foam die (~6 cm edge), same object as T1 (t1_protocol.json)

targets.description: The four ~5x5 cm colour squares printed on the mat (mat coordinates, cm, from layout/t1_layout_3d.html; +-0.5 cm photo estimates).

reach_estimate_cm.method: affine fit of the 2026-10-15 pilot reach check (A1/A3/C1 dwell poses in the base frame; C3 residual 1.8 cm); horizontal distance from the base yaw axis, +-2 cm
reach_estimate_cm.warning: yellow is at the nominal reach limit for a vertical gripper (~50-52 cm with the 24 cm tool). Check it in the pilot reach check; placing may use a tilted wrist and a release a few cm above the mat. If it cannot be reached, drop yellow and record 20 each of red/green/purple instead of moving the mat.

outcome_categories: cube released with its centre inside the commanded square
cube released on a DIFFERENT colour square (note which colour)
never held the cube (missed / pushed it)
grasped, dropped before reaching any square
no task progress before the end (hesitation / freeze)
controller fault, hold latch or policy lost
anything else; describe in the note
scene: Same table, mat placement (mat_offset_cm 12.3), cameras and lighting as T1; do NOT move the mat, so the pending T1 Diffusion evaluation still runs in the T1 scene. The T1 white box stays where it is and is not used. Generalization runs: everything as T2 unless the trial row says otherwise.

starts.description: Training starts from t2_protocol.json plus the unseen midpoints A12/A23/C12/C23 (4 cm from the nearest training start; >= 3.5 cm from every square at yaw 0).

distractors.objects: two medium rubber ducks (one yellow, one green), similar size

arrangements.A: yellow duck centred at mat (8, 6) cm, green duck at (34, 6) cm
arrangements.B: green duck centred at mat (8, 6) cm, yellow duck at (34, 6) cm (A swapped)

distractors.note: candidate positions near the arm-side mat edge, off the cube-to-square paths; confirm clearance and camera view in the pre-check, photograph each arrangement, then keep them fixed

evaluation.design: Primary 36 = 4 blocks x 9 (3 controls + 2 spatial + 2 language + 2 clutter per block), one change per dimension against the B2/A2/C2 yaw-0 canonical setup; every colour appears 3x in controls and 2x in each challenge dimension; order shuffled within a block (seed 20261019) with no colour twice in a row. Block 5 (6 trials) is exploratory and reported separately: 2 Chinese instructions, 4 blue duck. Policy: pi0.5 only, sync chunk mode (same as the 20/20 fixed-layout run). Keep every failure; mark a trial invalid only for a setup error, and say why.
